tools.name: search_emails
tools.title: Search Emails
tools.description: Search Gmail messages using a query string. Returns message metadata (id, subject, from, date, snippet).

tools.name: read_email
tools.title: Read Email
tools.description: Fetch the full content of a Gmail message by its ID.

tools.name: draft_email
tools.title: Draft Email
tools.description: Create a Gmail draft with optional file attachments. Optionally threads as a reply by providing reply_to_message_id.

reply_to_message_id.description: Gmail message ID to reply to

attachments.description: Files to attach. Total base64 size must be under 25 MB (~18.5 MB raw). For larger files, share a Drive link in the body instead.

content.description: File content encoded as standard base64 (A-Za-z0-9+/=). Strip any existing newlines before passing.

tools.name: list_labels
tools.title: List Labels
tools.description: List all Gmail labels (system and user-created).
